cases.sentence: Позволь нам пойти к ___, взять оттуда по бревну.
cases.translation: Allow us to go to the Jordan, and take each a beam from there.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они пришли к Иордану и начали рубить ___.
cases.translation: They came to the Jordan and began to cut down trees.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb 'рубить' (to cut).

cases.sentence: железное лезвие его топора упало в ___.
cases.translation: The iron ax head fell into the water.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) governs the accusative case when indicating motion toward.

cases.translation: The king of Syria was at war against Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Не скажете ли вы мне, кто из наших людей на стороне ___ Израиля?
cases.translation: Won't you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession or association.

cases.translation: They came by night, and surrounded the city.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb 'окружили' (surrounded).

cases.sentence: вокруг Елисея по всей горе были огненные кони и ___.
cases.translation: The mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb 'были' (were) and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Они вернулись к своему ___, и отряды из Арама перестали совершать набеги.
cases.translation: They returned to their master, and the bands of Syria stopped raiding.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Ученики пророков сказали Елисею, «Послушай, здесь, где мы живем, под твоим началом нам не хватает места».
reading.question: What problem did the sons of the prophets describe to Elisha?
options: There was not enough food to eat
There was not enough space for them to live
reading.correct: There was not enough space for them to live
reading.explain: They said 'нам не хватает места' — we don't have enough space.

reading.ru: Когда один из них валил дерево, железное лезвие его топора упало в воду.
reading.question: What accident happened while the disciples were cutting down trees?
options: A man was injured by a falling tree
The iron ax head fell into the water
A tree fell on a child
reading.correct: The iron ax head fell into the water
reading.explain: The text says 'железное лезвие его топора упало в воду' — the iron ax head fell into the water.

reading.ru: Не раз и не два Елисей предостерегал царя, и тот бывал в таких местах на стороже.
reading.question: How often did Elisha warn the king of Israel about Syrian ambushes?
reading.explain: The text states 'Не раз и не два Елисей предостерегал царя' — more than once or twice did Elisha warn the king.

reading.ru: Это Елисей, пророк, что в Израиле. Передает царю Израиля даже те слова, которые ты говоришь у себя в спальне.
reading.question: Why was the king of Syria troubled by Elisha's presence?
options: Because Elisha was leading an army against him
Because Elisha knew and told the king of Israel even the words the Syrian king spoke in his bedroom
Because Elisha refused to help him
reading.correct: Because Elisha knew and told the king of Israel even the words the Syrian king spoke in his bedroom
reading.explain: The servant said Elisha 'Передает царю Израиля даже те слова, которые ты говоришь у себя в спальне' — tells the king of Israel even your private words.

reading.ru: Когда рано утром слуга Божьего человека поднялся и вышел, город был окружен войском с конями и колесницами.
reading.question: What did Elisha's servant see when he went outside early in the morning?
options: The city surrounded by an army with horses and chariots
reading.correct: The city surrounded by an army with horses and chariots
reading.explain: The text says 'город был окружен войском с конями и колесницами' — the city was surrounded by an army with horses and chariots.

reading.ru: В городе начался страшный голод. Осада так затянулась, что ослиную голову продавали за 80 шекелей серебра.
reading.question: How severe was the famine during the siege of Samaria?
options: Food was scarce but still affordable
An ass's head was sold for eighty pieces of silver
People had plenty of grain stored
reading.correct: An ass's head was sold for eighty pieces of silver
reading.explain: The text states the famine was so severe that 'ослиную голову продавали за 80 шекелей серебра' — a donkey's head was sold for 80 pieces of silver.
